Elena M.: Hey team — customer (acct acme-corp) reporting a surge of declines for one merchant integration. They say AVS/CVV mismatches when cardholder insists data is correct. Error from gateway: `avs= N, cvv= N, issuer_response=DECLINED` :confused:
Omar S.: Got txn IDs?
Elena M.: Sample txns: tx_8b9f3a, tx_8b9f3b, tx_8b9f3c. Happening across multiple BINs, but mostly cards issued in KR. Customer claims we started normalizing addresses (removing special chars) in last deploy — could be zips or hyphen handling.
Ravi (payments): Sending to acquirer now. Quick check: can you paste the raw request payload (PII redacted) and gateway response? Also which connector? (stripe/adyen/our-bridge)
Elena M.: Connector: acme-bridge -> acquirer
